result.summary: The page is generally polished, but a few elements appear clipped or stuck in an incomplete loading state.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is visibly overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, making the restaurant card look unfinished or stuck loading.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loader once the image/content loads, or provide a fallback image and error state if loading fails.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge, with only part of the next chip visible.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearly scrollable carousel with appropriate padding or fade indicators, or wrap the chips to avoid an accidental-looking cutoff.

issues.description: The restaurant carousel's third card and its name are clipped by the right edge of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has intentional peek spacing and scrolling behavior, or adjust card sizing so the visible clipping is clearly deliberate.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the next popular restaurant card, hiding part of its content and image.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable page content equal to the navigation bar height so cards can be fully viewed above the navigation.
